Contact & Placement Test

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers about the current contact and request-preparation setup.

View Contact Channels
Is the placement test free?

The page currently presents the free placement test as the recommended first step. Final booking flow and contact method can be connected later.

Can I choose a course directly?

Yes. Students can explore Courses first, but the placement test helps choose the right track based on stage, level, and goals.

Can I ask about video access?

Yes. Students and parents can ask about curriculum videos, free previews, locked lessons, and subscription access.

Is online booking active now?

Online booking is not fully connected yet. This page prepares the contact and placement-test request structure.

Which contact channel should I use?

Use the available Englishine channels shown on this page. Exact contact links can be added once finalized.
